The '''''Lucky Dragon''''' was a [[Hapan Battle Dragon]] used by the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]. After the [[Second Battle of Fondor]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the Hapes Consortium provided the ''Lucky Dragon'' to patrol the [[Transitory Mists]]. After her encounter with her [[Darth Caedus|brother]] at [[Nickel One]], the ''Lucky Dragon'' gave [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] medical aid.
